maddeler.e:
امتطين (form VIII)
# اِمْتَطَيْنَ (imtaṭayna) /im.ta.tˤaj.na/: third-person feminine plural past active of اِمْتَطَى (imtaṭā)
# اُمْتُطِينَ (umtuṭīna) /um.tu.tˤiː.na/: third-person feminine plural past passive of اِمْتَطَى (imtaṭā)
# اِمْتَطِينَ (imtaṭīna) /im.ta.tˤiː.na/: second-person feminine plural imperative of اِمْتَطَى (imtaṭā)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
